name: Staff of Thunder and Lightning

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Lightning
powers.text: Arm it (once per dawn): your next melee hit with the staff deals an extra 2d6 Lightning.

powers.name: Thunder
powers.text: Arm it (once per dawn): your next melee hit makes the target save (Con DC 17) or be Stunned until the end of your next turn.

powers.name: Lightning Strike
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): a 120-ft bolt, 5 ft wide (Dex DC 17, 9d6 Lightning, half on a success).

powers.name: Thunderclap
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): everything within 60 ft makes a Con save (DC 17) or takes 2d6 Thunder and is Deafened for 1 minute (half and not Deafened on a success).

powers.name: Thunder and Lightning
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): Lightning Strike and Thunderclap together, without using up either.

summary: +2 quarterstaff with a daily Lightning hit, Thunder hit, Lightning Strike, Thunderclap, and both at once.
text: A magic Quarterstaff with +2 to attack and damage rolls and five storm powers. Each power is usable once per dawn. Lightning: on a melee hit with the staff, you can have the target take 2d6 extra Lightning damage. Thunder: when you land a melee hit, the staff can let out a boom heard up to 300 feet away, and the target must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 17) or be Stunned until your next turn ends. Lightning Strike: as a Magic action, loose a bolt from the tip in a Line 120 feet long and 5 feet wide; everything in it rolls a Dexterity saving throw against DC 17, suffering 9d6 Lightning damage if it fails or half as much if it succeeds. Thunderclap: as a Magic action, set off a deafening crash heard up to 600 feet away. Every other creature in a 60-foot radius around you rolls a Constitution saving throw against DC 17: a failure means 2d6 Thunder damage and being Deafened for 1 minute, while a success means only half the damage. Thunder and Lightning: as a Magic action, unleash Lightning Strike and Thunderclap together; this spends only this power's daily use, leaving those two still available.
